area: Wave 7: firewall migration from Palo Alto Networks, a terminal UI, local plugins and update notifications
title: PAN-OS export to a Bulk changes plan (Cloud Firewall and ZPA), the curses TUI over the same API and gates, hash-allow-listed local plugins with a narrow API, update notices once per version

checks.what: PAN-OS XML parsed with defusedxml (hash-pinned in requirements.lock): DTD, entity (internal, external, UTF-16 disguised) and external references refused; size, depth and element caps
A rule with any part that cannot be carried exactly is listed with the reason, never trimmed or widened; catch-alls not duplicated
Firewall import: Scope rule before any read, preview with plan hash, typed phrase always, re-read before each create, rules DISABLED, read-back, Undo deletes rules first
The plan is untrusted: names, prefix ownership, references, addresses, ports, actions and network applications checked again on the server
TUI: a client of the server's own API; writes need the typed phrase locally and every gate on the server; token never shown; escape sequences stripped; plain http only to loopback
Local plugins off by default; an unlisted or modified plugin (hash mismatch, extra file, link) is refused and its code never runs; hashed bytes are the ones run
Plugin operations go through the engine's gates; the planner's client is read-only; writes only inside an apply; per-user enablement
Update notices: off by default, once per version, only on the digests' channel, no path or secret in the message

findings.title: Gap: no firewall or private-access migration from Palo Alto Networks (only DLP vendors were migrated)
findings.fix: panos_migrate.py builds a plan from a PAN-OS export; ops_fw_import.py applies its ZIA part on Bulk changes; the ZPA part feeds the existing ZPA builders

findings.title: No hardened XML parser in the runtime lock: an XML upload relied on a hand-written DTD refusal
findings.fix: defusedxml 0.7.1 added to requirements.txt and requirements.lock with hashes (SBOM and notices regenerated); the PAN-OS reader uses it with forbid_dtd, forbid_entities and forbid_external

findings.title: Gap: Bulk changes had no way to create IP source groups or network services (pack_ops kinds)
findings.fix: pack_ops create/update/delete take ip_source_group and network_service (SDK cloud_firewall add_/update_/delete_ip_source_group and _network_service)

findings.title: Gap: no terminal UI for SSH sessions
findings.fix: tui.py and the `tui` subcommand of zscaler-made-easy and dlp-check

findings.title: Gap: no opt-in extension point outside the app's own modules; a Bulk changes type without a page script would show an endless 'Loading the form'
findings.fix: local_plugins.py (hash allow-list, narrow API) and a generic JSON form on Bulk changes for a type that ships no script

findings.title: Gap: a newer app version was announced only on the page; no notice on the digest channel
findings.fix: update_notify.py, called from the update check, once per version, off by default

findings.title: The sample tenant has no network applications list, so a firewall import previewed on it excludes the rules that name an application
findings.reason: sample_tenant.py is shared by every page's answers; the import is exercised with fakes that carry the list, and the preview on the sample says why those rules are excluded
